e-seo-pro.8.evidence: guest GET of a Customer Advisory Board topic -> 404 'Page not available' page; no topic title, og tags or JSON-LD of the space.

e-seo-pro.15.evidence: each PATCH to the space SEO (title, noindex, description) was visible in the very next guest page fetch with no manual cache clear.
